meta.scope: Released PC/console playable character roster and equipable perks, including delisted characters still playable by existing owners. Cosmetic character variants, unused perks, and unreleased/PTB-only content are excluded.

field_notes.id: Stable source IDs from dbd.tricky.lol; never use translated display names as keys.
field_notes.english_and_spanish: Localized source names. Yun-Jin Lee is normalized to the official roster spelling in both languages.
field_notes.type: Special perk family inferred from the English prefix: hex, boon, scourge_hook, invocation, or teamwork. Null means no named family, not a missing perk.
field_notes.tags: Gameplay tags from the maintained wiki loadout table; useful for filters such as Exhausted, Auras, Healing, and Generators.
field_notes.survivor_origin_and_killer_origin: Original character name and stable ID. Null for perks that debuted as general perks. Original attribution remains populated for the nine perks subsequently made general.
field_notes.is_general: Whether the perk is currently available in the general Bloodweb pool, regardless of original character attribution.
field_notes.general_variant: For the nine Halloween/Hellraiser perks, the main names are the character-owned localized names; this object contains the general-pool display name and icon. Spanish is null because a verified localized general-pool name was not available. Use the main Spanish name as the display fallback.
field_notes.perk_ids: References into perks.survivors or perks.killers; name variants share one record so roulettes do not double-count them.
field_notes.available_to_unlock: False for Laurie Strode, The Shape, and The Cenobite; they remain playable for existing owners.
field_notes.image_url: External PNG URLs resolved from the official character assets or wiki image API. Assets are not bundled or hosted by this repository.
